content: Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Eli wi u wɑ̃ɑ Tisibiɔ Gɑlɑdin temɔ u sinɑ boko Akɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni wi nɑ sɑ̃ɑmɔ minin wɑ̃ɑru, ɡurɑ kɑ kɑkoru, yen ɡɑɑ kun mɑɑ nɛmɔ wɔ̃ɔ sinin bɑɑ sɔɔ sere dɔmɑ te nɑ wure nɑ nɛɛ, yɑ koo nɛ.
Eli u wɑ̃ɑ
dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Keritiɔ
Yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Eli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑ seewo minin di kpɑ ɑ dɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ Keritin dɑɑrɔ Yuudɛnin ɡuruɔ.
Dɑɑ ten nimɑ kɑɑ n dɑ n nɔrumɔ kpɑ n ɡunɔmɔri ɡɔrimɑ yi kɑ nun dĩɑnu nɑɑwɑ.
Mɑ Eli u doonɑ min di u kuɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. U dɑ u wɑ̃ɑ dɑɑ ten mi.
Yerɑ ɡunɔmɔri yi, yi rɑ kɑ nùn pɛ̃ɛ kɑ yɑɑ nɑɑwɛ bururu kɑ yokɑ. Dɑɑ ten nimɑ u rɑ n mɑɑ nɔrumɔ.
Eli kɑ kurɔ ɡɔmini ɡoo
Sɑrepɑtɑɔ
Sɑnɑm dɔɔ sɑnɑm wee, dɑɑ ten nim mu kpɑ. Domi ɡurɑ kun mɑɑ nɛɛre tem mɛ sɔɔ.
Yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kpɑm Eli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑ seewo ɑ dɑ Sɑrepɑtɑɔ, Sidonin temɔ, kpɑ ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ mi. Domi nɑ ɡɔmini ɡoo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nun diisiɑ.
Mɑ u seewɑ u dɑ Sɑrepɑtɑ mi. Ye u wuu ɡe duɔ, yerɑ u deemɑ ɡɔmini ɡoo wee, u dɑ̃ɑ kɑsu. Mɑ u nùn sokɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ suuru koowo ɑ doo, ɑ mɑn nim kɑsuɑmɑ fiiko n nɔ.
Ye u nim mɛ kɑso dɔɔ, Eli u kpɑm nùn sokɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑn pɛ̃ɛ kpiribu kɑsuɑmɑ mi, n nɔɔ kpɛ̃ɛ.

Mɑ kurɔ wi, u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinnin wɑ̃ɑru, nɑ ǹ dĩɑ yebunu ɡɑnu mɔ yɛnuɔ, mɑ n kun mɔ som nɔm kure teeru te nɑ mɔ kɑɑrɔ kɑ sere mɑɑ ɡum fiiko bwɑ̃ɑrɔ. Yen dɑ̃ɑ nɑ kɑsu mini, nɑ̀ n sĩɑ yɛnuɔ, n kɑ doo ko su di kɑ nɛn bii. Yen biru kpɑ sɑ n ɡɔɔ mɑrɑ.
Eli u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ku bɛrum ko, ɑ doo ɑ ko nɡe mɛ ɑ ɡeruɑ. Adɑmɑ ɑ ɡinɑ mɑn kirɑ piibu kuɑmɑ kɑ som mɛ. Yen biru kpɑ ɑ wunɛ kɑ wunɛn biiɡiru ko.
Domi Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, som mɛ mu wɑ̃ɑ kɑɑ te sɔɔ, kɑ ɡum mɛ mu wɑ̃ɑ bwɑ̃ɑ te sɔɔ, mu ǹ kpeemɔ pɑi, sere n kɑ ko tɔ̃ɔ te u koo de ɡurɑ yu nɛ.
Mɑ u dɑ u kuɑ nɡe mɛ Eli u ɡeruɑ. Wi kɑ win yɛnuɡibu kɑ Elin tii bɑ mɑɑ wɑ bɑ di sɔ̃ɔ dɑbi dɑbinu.
Som mɛ, kɑ ɡum mɛ, mu ǹ kpɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ win sɔmɔ Elin nɔɔn di.
Eli u kurɔ ɡɔmini win bii
wesiɑ wɑsiru
Yenibɑn biru, kurɔ win bii u bɑrɑ ɡem ɡem mɑ u ɡu.
Yerɑ u Eli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔn tɔnu wunɛ, ɑ nɑwɑ ɑ kɑ Gusunɔ nɛn torɑnu yɑɑyɑsiɑ? Domi wee nɛn bii u ɡu.
Eli u kurɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑn bii wi wɛ̃ɛmɑ. Mɑ u nùn mwɑ kurɔ win nɔmɑn di u kɑ dɑ dii ten ɡidɑmbisɑn wɔllɔ mi u rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ. Mɑ u nùn kpĩ win kpin yerɔ.
Mɑ u Yinni Gusunɔ kɑnɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni kɑɑ dewɑ kɔ̃sɑ yu kurɔ wi deemɑ wìn mi nɑ sɔbiɑ? Kpɑ ɑ de win bii u ɡbi?
Yerɑ u bii wi kibɑrisi nɔn itɑ u Gusunɔ kɑnɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni, ɑ de bii wi, u se.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Elin kɑnɑ te mwɑ, bii win wɛ̃siɑrɑ wurɑmɑ u kuɑ wɑso.
Yerɑ Eli u nùn suɑmɑ u kɑ sɑrɑmɑ wɑsiru u nùn win mɛro wɛ̃. U nɛɛ, wunɛn bii wee.
Mɑ kurɔ wi, u Eli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, tɛ̃, nɑ ɡiɑ mɑ Gusunɔn tɔnuwɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ. Gɑri yi ɑ mɑɑ ɡerumɔ yi sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡem, yi weewɑ Gusunɔn min di.
Eli u nɛɛ,
ɡurɑ koo mɑɑ wurɑmɑ
